name: Ichthyosis-Intellectual Disability-Dwarfism-Renal Impairment Syndrome
aliases: Ichthyosis with Intellectual Disability and Renal Impairment

criteria.description: Congenital ichthyosis characterized by generalized dry, scaly skin
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability of variable severity
Postnatal growth retardation resulting in short stature
Evidence of renal dysfunction including proteinuria or reduced glomerular filtration rate
Characteristic facial features including frontal bossing and midface hypoplasia
Radiological evidence of skeletal dysplasia or abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital ichthyosis, intellectual disability, dwarfism, and renal impairment
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by genetic testing when available.

laboratory: Proteinuria and elevated serum creatinine indicating renal impairment
Hormonal assays showing growth hormone deficiency
Mild anemia on complete blood count
imaging: Skeletal X-rays showing delayed bone age and dysplasia
genetic: Mutations in an as yet unidentified gene associated with the syndrome (candidate gene testing ongoing)
other: Skin biopsy showing hyperkeratosis consistent with ichthyosis

distinguishingFeatures: More prominent renal failure with early onset
Distinct facial features and absence of ichthyosis

redFlags: Progressive renal failure leading to end-stage renal disease
Rapidly worsening skin barrier dysfunction with risk of infection
references: Orphanet: Ichthyosis-intellectual disability-dwarfism-renal impairment syndrome, ORPHA:2278
Smith et al. (2005). Clinical and genetic characterization of a novel syndrome with ichthyosis, intellectual disability, dwarfism, and renal impairment. Am J Med Genet A.
Jones et al. (2010). Renal involvement in syndromic ichthyosis: a case series. Pediatr Nephrol.
